title: WorkPlanTemplateEntry - Data API
description: Represents an object that associates a work step template with a work plan template. This object is available in API version 52.0 and later.

ExecutionOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExecutionOrder.description: The sequence number of when this entry is executed. Only positive values are supported.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last interacted with this record, directly or indirectly.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, it's possible that the user only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

WorkPlanTemplateEntryNumber.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
WorkPlanTemplateEntryNumber.description: The auto-generated number of the work plan template entry, for example, WPTE-0001.

WorkPlanTemplateId.description: The ID of the work plan template.

WorkStepTemplateId.description: The ID of the work step template.

associated_objects:

- **WorkPlanTemplateEntryFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **WorkPlanTemplateEntryHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
